Dear all,
I am a Zoology graduate currently based in Aberdeen, Scotland. I
carried out a census of Colobus monkeys using line transects and am
trying to to analyse the data using the Hazard rate model. My problems
are: the university computers do not give space for the windows
version so I have tried to use the DOS version. However I cannot get
the data entered in correctly. I was wondering if there is anyone in
the Aberdeen area who has used the DOS version for similar analysis
who is willing to spend some time guiding me through. Alternatively is
there anyone in the Aberdeen area who has access to the windows
version and could let me use their computer?
If you can help please reply to darr...@hotmail.com
I look forward to receiving your replies.
Darren Norris
